'''NorthWestern Energy Montana Gas Transmission System''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.northwesternenergy.com/our-company/about-us/natural-gas-transmission-and-storage|title=northwesternenergy.com|website=northwesternenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Montana.

*'''Length: '''2,100 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.northwesternenergy.com/our-company/about-us/natural-gas-transmission-and-storage|title=northwesternenergy.com|website=northwesternenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.northwesternenergy.com/our-company/about-us/natural-gas-transmission-and-storage|title=northwesternenergy.com|website=northwesternenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
